summary: This bill modifies Medicare requirements for ordering certain imaging services by requiring clinical decision support mechanisms to report data to the government, establishing new compliance rates for ordering professionals, and exempting some services and practices from these requirements, all effective January 1, 2026.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Social Security Act to modify data collection requirements for appropriate use criteria for imaging services under Medicare. It focuses on improving compliance and reporting mechanisms for these services, which directly impacts the administration and efficiency of healthcare services, particularly within the public healthcare system (Medicare).
